# Native Data Builder fixture

`native-text.btdb` was created in a fresh installed Data Builder window on 2026-10-21 using Create Data Table → Add Field/Text → enter `001 Tea` → Save Database. It contains a single generated ID and text row. It contains no user document data.

Original evidence file: `D:/QLabel-agent-work/rea-database-20261021/native-fixture.btdb`. Its XML schema version is 11.2.R0. Grid layout and system metadata are retained for realistic parsing tests but are never executed by the application parser.

The matching REA serializer analysis is recorded in `docs/database-provider-followup-2026-10-21.md`. Legacy SQL Server .btdb files and other schema versions require independent fixtures and remain unsupported by this parser.
